subject: Service Integrity Command — Meridian Commerce: throughput and error spike
messages:
From: Tom Lewis <t.lewis@meridiancorp.com>

Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@meridiancorp.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Major spike in 500s & throughput collapse — urgent

Diego,

We're seeing a sudden, sustained spike in 500 responses across our POST /v1/predict endpoints and a concurrent drop in throughput starting ~09:00 PDT. Error rate climbed from ~0.5% to ~15% in the last 10 minutes and our request queue is backing up — customers are noticing. Sample request ids attached from Meridian region: req-7f3c9, req-7f3d2, req-7f3ff.

We need an immediate triage and a timeline for remediation. Can you confirm receipt and who will be the point of contact? We're standing by in case you want to open a bridge.

Attachments: screenshot-500s.png

--
Tom Lewis
Head of Platform Operations
Meridian Commerce

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Major spike in 500s & throughput collapse — urgent

Thanks Tom — got it. Team: I'm initiating a Service Integrity Command for Meridian Commerce. Key asks for first 15 minutes:
- Marissa: can you pull the last 30m of model-serving telemetry (cpu/gpu utilization, queue length, KV cache metrics) and post in the bridge?
- Karthik: confirm autoscaler status and any recent config changes / pending drains.
- Neha: check routing logs for reject patterns and any region failovers.

Scheduling: propose a 09:30 immediate war-room (quick 10–15m triage) and 10:00 broader bridge with Meridian execs. Laura — please stand by to lead external comms.

I'm attaching the initial dump I captured from Tom's samples. I'll update in-channel; escalating to execs in 20 minutes if we don't have a containment plan.

Attachments: meridian-error-dump-20270518.log (placeholder)

--
Diego Fernandez
Support Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Lewis <t.lewis@meridiancorp.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@meridiancorp.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Major spike in 500s & throughput collapse — urgent

On it. Early telemetry notes:
- KV cache miss rate jumped ~8x at 08:58 and remained elevated; per-host GPU utilization is normal but queue depth is spiking on the routing layer.
- Autoscaler shows several pending launches (8 instances queued) with provisioning delay ~70–90s due to a transient image pull throttling we've seen in us-west-2 earlier this month.

Immediate containment proposal (can implement now):
1) Enable emergency routing to fallback pool (lower capacity but stable) for Meridian (will reduce throughput but stop 500s).
2) Temporarily increase per-worker concurrency limit and enable aggressive prefix caching for the affected model unsigned-2027q2-v2.
3) Kick the autoscaler to prioritize warm pool recycles (manual bump by +20% capacity).

I'll attach our runbook snippet and the checklist for quick activation. Executing step 1 now and will report back.

Attachments: runbook-activation-checklist.pdf

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Lewis <t.lewis@meridiancorp.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Major spike in 500s & throughput collapse — urgent

Confirming auto-scale backlog and image pull retries. I'm standing up emergency routing policy now (routing->fallback) and will run a controlled rolling restart on two worker groups after the fallback is live — that should relieve queue pressure without a full fleet restart.

Immediate commands I'm running (sanitized):
- routing set-policy meridian --policy fallback --priority emergency
- autoscaler set-surge --pool meridian-warm --percent 20

Laura: please draft an exec-facing one-paragraph status update we can send at 09:50.

--
Karthik Iyer
Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Lewis <t.lewis@meridiancorp.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@meridiancorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:50:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian Service Update — immediate mitigation in progress

Tom / Samira — quick update from the Service Integrity Command: we have enabled an emergency routing fallback for your tenant and applied targeted cache tuning and a +20% warm-pool surge. Early signs: error rate trending down but throughput is still reduced while instances finish provisioning.

Next milestones:
- 10:05: expected stabilizing window (reduction in 500s to <1–2%)
- 10:30: normal throughput target or near-normal depending on provisioning completion

Point of contact: Laura Bennett (cc'd) will be your exec liaison for customer comms. Karthik and Marissa are on the operational bridge; I'll stay on until we confirm recovery.

Attachments: meridian-error-dump-20270518.log, runbook-activation-checklist.pdf

If you'd like a bridge, we can open one now — otherwise we'll send a 10:05 status update.

--
Diego Fernandez
Support Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Tom Lewis <t.lewis@meridiancorp.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@meridiancorp.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian status: containment complete — next steps and RCA planning

All — final status update for now. Containment complete: emergency routing + cache tuning and the warm-pool surge brought error rate back to baseline (~0.6%) by ~10:40. Throughput recovered to ~92% of expected capacity by 10:50 after all warm instances came online.

Actions taken:
- Emergency fallback routing enabled for 45m (reverted at 10:55).
- Targeted cache settings applied to unsigned-2027q2-v2 to reduce miss amplification.
- Manual warm-pool surge completed and autoscaler review scheduled.

Next steps:
- We will prepare an RCA and mitigation plan (OPS-4829). Draft RCA will be shared by EOD; post-mortem call scheduled for 14:00 PDT today.
- Laura (CS) and Diego (Support) will coordinate executive comms for Meridian; Tom / Samira, expect a summary and 14:00 invite.

Attachments: OPS-4829-RCA-draft.pdf

Thanks for the quick cross-functional response — plz flag any outstanding action items in the OPS ticket.

--
Laura Bennett

Redwood Inference
